title: 第12章 日不落要塞

content_zh:
“团长，我看我们没得救了。”魔法师贝法苦笑道。
他已经缩到了队伍的最中间了，没有魔力的魔法师连一个稍微强壮的战士都抵不上。
肯斯苦涩的点了点头：“哎，都怪我，当初一定要坚持接下这个任务。。”
“团长，你也别自责了，我们不也是赞成了的嘛。”精灵在一旁安慰道，手上的弓箭似连弩一般的快速射出。
矮人巴达斯也明白是自己连累了大家，沉默了下来，手中挥舞的铁锤也慢了下来。
一头“残暴血狼”趁机猛扑了过来，锋利的爪牙闪着幽青的光芒，向矮人的头颅抓去。
“小心。”
一支铁箭在“残暴血狼”将要扑到矮人头上之时，准确的射进它的喉腔，鲜血溅出，喷了矮人一脸。
被温烫的鲜血一淋，矮人一个哆嗦，回过了神来，有些讪讪的笑了笑。
***********
看着越来越无力的同伴，肯斯露出了一个苦涩的笑容。
“看来，的确是完了。”
“呵呵，肯斯大叔，想不到在这里都会遇到你。”一声轻笑从远处传来。
听见这熟悉的笑声，肯斯犹如绝处逢生的大喜过望，狂喜的喊道：“小枫，是你吗？快点帮忙出个手。”转过头，对着三位同伴轻松的笑道：“我们有救了，放心，等会就可以回去了。”
三人有些面面相觑，不知道团长哪里来的这么大的信心。
就算是七阶高手，也最多只能在这么多“残暴血狼”口中逃出吧，想要多带几个人逃出去，还真是有点不现实。
“呵呵，好勒。”
随着一声轻飘飘的话语，一条人影忽的诡异的出现在众人面前。
矮人三人心中猛的一跳，这什么速度？好诡异。
再望上看去，一位看上去顶多只有二十开头的年轻人，在寿命颇长的精灵和矮人心中，这还只是一个牙都还没长齐的少年娃。

心中有些怀疑：“团长，对他这么有信心？”
肯斯看着气势尤胜当初的刘枫，心中明白，他一定是在实力上又有了突破。
喜色显露，豪迈的笑道：“小枫，没想到，我上次的命还没还你，又要被你救一次了。”
刘枫微微一笑：“肯斯大叔，不也是进阶了嘛。”
“这怎么敢和你比。”
俩人都视周围环顾的狼群于无物。
这让三人有些不明白，刚才还担心的要死的团长，怎么冒出了这么大的豪气？
刘枫艺高人大胆，当然不会把这几只小狼看在眼里。
而肯斯却深受那次在死亡森林的震撼，对刘枫有着极大的信心。
“额。。那个。那个。老大。你看是不是先把这群狼给解决了，再聊啊。”矮人巴达斯弱弱的举手问道。
俩人闻言，不禁哑然失笑。
“呵呵，那我还把这些畜生解决了再聊吧。”刘枫笑道。
“那就麻烦了。”肯斯抱拳大笑道。
底下三人也赶紧伸长了脖子，看这位貌似高人的年轻人，杂个解决这么大群狼？
左手内劲一吸，一大蓬草叶离地而去，被吸入了刘枫那修长白皙的手掌。
指间疾弹，每一片脆弱的草叶在此刻变成了杀狼利器。
草叶被内力灌注，宛如金刚一般坚硬。
带着“呜呜”的响声，在虚空之中划过条条淡淡的青痕。
每片都不落空，夹着破空之声，从众狼的喉间穿过，带走一条条凶恶的灵魂。
三人嘴巴大张，惊得说不出话来，就连肯斯也是满脸的震撼。

虽然早知道这位兄弟很牛，但还是没想到。。竟然。。这么牛。
那可是一扯就碎的草叶啊。
那可是能抵御俩阶斗气的狼皮啊。
原本天差地别的俩样物品啊，在这一瞬间就被调翻了地位。
草原之上一片寂静，风都似乎凝结了起来。
轻轻拍了拍手，除去手上残留的青青草屑。
“走吧，还愣在这里干嘛？”
声音惊醒了呆滞中的四人。
慢慢的回过了神来，看向刘枫的眼中尽是崇拜。
若不是还有一丝理智的话，说不定现在已经扑过去请求签名了。。。
“呵呵，小枫，越来越厉害了，来我来跟你介绍一下，这三个不成器的小子。”肯斯大笑一声，对着刘枫说道。
三人听见团长这般说，都不是由的现出一脸苦相来。
肯斯指着身着红色魔法袍的年轻人，笑道。
“这是魔法师，贝法，四阶火系魔法师，整天吹嘘自己是未来的星辰大魔导，不过很明显，他是没指望了。”

content_en:
"Captain, I think we are hopeless." The magician Befa said with a bitter smile.
He has shrunk to the middle of the team. A magician without magic power cannot even compete with a slightly stronger warrior.
Kensi nodded bitterly: "Hey, it's all my fault. I had to insist on taking on this mission..."
"Captain, don't blame yourself, we also agreed." The elf comforted from the side, and the bow and arrow in his hand shot out quickly like a repeating crossbow.
The dwarf Badas also understood that he had caused everyone trouble, so he fell silent, and the hammer he swung in his hand also slowed down.
A "brutal blood wolf" took the opportunity to pounce over, its sharp claws flashing with a green light, and grabbed the dwarf's head.
"Be careful."
When the "Cruel Blood Wolf" was about to pounce on the dwarf's head, an iron arrow accurately shot into its throat. Blood splashed out and sprayed all over the dwarf's face.
Being drenched by the warm blood, the dwarf shuddered, came to his senses, and smiled somewhat coquettishly.
***********
Looking at his increasingly powerless companion, Kensi showed a bitter smile.
"It seems that it is indeed over."
"Haha, Uncle Kensi, I never thought I would meet you here." A chuckle came from a distance.
Hearing this familiar laughter, Kensi was overjoyed as if he had survived a desperate situation, and shouted ecstatically: "Xiao Feng, is that you? Please help me quickly." He turned his head and smiled relaxedly at his three companions: "We are saved, don't worry, we can go back later."
The three of them looked at each other in confusion, wondering where the leader got such confidence.
Even a seventh-level master can only escape from the mouths of so many "brutal blood wolves". It is really unrealistic to want to lead a few more people to escape.
"Haha, that's good."
Following a soft word, a figure suddenly and strangely appeared in front of everyone.
The hearts of the three dwarves jumped fiercely. What speed is this? So weird.
Looking up again, he saw a young man who looked to be in his early twenties at most. In the eyes of elves and dwarves who had long lifespans, this was just a boy whose teeth had not yet grown.
There was some doubt in my heart: "Captain, do you have so much confidence in him?"
Kensi looked at Liu Feng, who was even more powerful than before, and knew in his heart that he must have made another breakthrough in strength.
His joy showed, and he smiled boldly: "Xiao Feng, I didn't expect that before I could repay you with my life last time, I would have to be saved by you again."
Liu Feng smiled slightly: "Uncle Kensi, isn't he also advanced?"
"How dare I compare with you?"
Both of them ignored the wolves surrounding them.
This made the three people a little confused. How could the leader, who was worried to death just now, be so heroic?
Liu Fengyi is an expert and bold, and of course he will not take these little wolves seriously.
But Kensi was deeply shocked by that time in the Forest of Death, and had great confidence in Liu Feng.
"Um...that...that...boss. Do you want to deal with these wolves first, and then we can talk." The dwarf Badas weakly raised his hand and asked.
When the two heard this, they couldn't help laughing.
"Haha, let's talk after I deal with these beasts." Liu Feng said with a smile.
"That'll be troublesome." Kens clasped his fists and laughed.
The three people below also quickly stretched their necks to see how this young man who seemed to be an expert could deal with such a large group of wolves?
With a breath of energy in his left hand, a large blade of grass flew away from the ground and was sucked into Liu Feng's slender and white palm.
With a quick flick of the fingers, every fragile blade of grass turned into a weapon for killing wolves.
The blades of grass are infused with internal force and are as hard as diamond.
With a "Woo" sound, faint blue marks were drawn in the void.
Each piece is not missing, and with the sound of breaking through the sky, it passes through the throats of the wolves, taking away the vicious souls one by one.
The three of them opened their mouths wide and were speechless in shock. Even Kensi's face was full of shock.
AlthoughI already knew that this brother was awesome, but I still didn’t expect it. . it turns out. . So awesome.
Those are blades of grass that break into pieces when pulled.
That is a wolf skin that can withstand two levels of fighting spirit.
The two items, which were originally very different, were reversed in this moment.
There was silence on the grassland, and the wind seemed to have condensed.
He patted his hands gently to remove the remaining green grass clippings on his hands.
"Let's go, why are you still hanging around here?"
The sound woke up the four people who were stunned.
Slowly he came back to his senses and looked at Liu Feng with admiration in his eyes.
If he hadn't had a shred of sense left, he might have jumped over to ask for an autograph by now. . .
"Haha, Xiao Feng is getting more and more powerful. Let me introduce to you these three incompetent boys." Kensi laughed and said to Liu Feng.
When the three of them heard what the leader said, they all had grim expressions on their faces.
Kensi pointed at the young man in red magic robe and smiled.
"This is the magician, Beifa, a fourth-level fire magician. He brags all day long that he is the future Great Mage of the Stars, but it is obvious that he has no hope."
